{{Quote|But what we choose to remember is the story of the war as told through the ''[&hellip;]'' fleet element that held the line at the Second Battle of Brightday.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
A celestial body located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], '''Brightday''' was the site of the [[Second Battle of Brightday]] during the [[7811 BBY]] conflict known as the [[Waymancy Storm]]. In addition, more than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] [[Darsius]] deployed a line of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] at Brightday. Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Brightday was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
Brightday was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Brightday system/Legends|Brightday system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="Northern" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Brightday shared its name with the nearby [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] celestial body [[Upper Brightday]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
[[File:Wullf_Yularen_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|right|300px|During his youth, Wullf Yularen (pictured) was interested in Darsius' actions at Brightday.]]
During the [[Waymancy Storm]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of [[7811 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> Brightday was the site of an engagement known as the [[Second Battle of Brightday]]. During the battle, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] element held the line, which the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] later noted as one of the heroic moments of the war at a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

More than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] [[Darsius]] deployed a line of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] at Brightday. In [[Time/Legends|time]], the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], a future [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]], quizzed his [[Parent/Legends|father]], the legendary [[Planetary Security Forces]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Thull Yularen]], on how Darsius accomplished the feat at Brightday. The astronomical object later fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brightday was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Brightday [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square K-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
